prompt: The shuffled list is the same every time the program runs. Why?
choices: The fixed seed 99 causes the same shuffle permutation every run
The list must be sorted before shuffling
new Random(99) and new Random() are equivalent
explanation: Collections.shuffle(list, random) uses the provided Random instance. A fixed seed produces the same shuffle each time. Fix: Collections.shuffle(nums) — uses an internally seeded Random.
